about: values(cfg) (bin/render): the placeholder values, or the message it exits with; toml null is examples/config/config.toml

values.pr_footer: Opened by a maintenance bot (Claude Code).

rows.name: missing-identity
rows.exit: config.toml is missing: git_name, git_email, pr_footer (see [identity] and [host])

rows.name: minimal
rows.toml:
[identity]
git_name = "Bot"
git_email = "bot@example.com"
pr_footer = "By a bot."
[host]
factory_uid = 1001
